Hello everyone,
Here is a complete remake of my old 3D work, The Landlord (Part 1). This is the first part of the story, and two more parts will be made in the future.
Every single panel has been completely remade and re-illustrated by hand, with zero use of artificial intelligence.

🔒 Special Note for my (2400 JPY) Subscribers:

As a special thank you for your premium support, another exclusive Extended Edition is currently in development and will drop right here for you later this month.
This premium expansion introduces 15 entirely new, unreleased pages made to expand the narrative, flesh out the main characters, and shed deeper light on their untold backgrounds.

You can get the full uncensored version on my Patreon:

Patreon.com/LIZ225A

There's also a fully censored version on:

liz225.fanbox.cc

If you enjoy my work and want me to continue, consider supporting me. You can also order your own comic right now, with your favorite characters and scenes, by subscribing to one of the Comic Maker or Comic Maker Plus tiers.
